about_the_game:
Reality is fracturing across Akinori as twisted echoes of once-defeated foes emerge from a forgotten fragment of the Dragonium.
Explore distorted versions of familiar lands, face deadly variants of legendary enemies, and uncover a new story that reveals what the Impact tried to bury.

short_description: Something has resurfaced from the shadow of the Impact. The boundaries between reality and memory are breaking. A forgotten fragment of the Dragonium is altering reality. Explore distorted areas and uncover the secrets the Impact tried to bury in this new chapter.
